input_files.rule: Repository guidance, effective configuration evidence, commands, structure, and fixtures are inputs. Documented defaults do not prove effective local configuration.

contracts.output contract: Return an evidence-first audit with conditional proposed diffs, or an authorized update summary with changed files and honest validation states. Keep AGENTS instruction need separate from code_map navigation need.
contracts.rollback boundary: All package behavior is local prompt, reference, metadata, fixture, and report content. Repository guidance edits remain limited to the caller-authorized files; user-global and external writes are outside the default boundary.
